entities.summary: Adal Sultanate, a political institution in Djibouti during Islamic Sultanates and Trade (1200–1577). Grew from Adal Sultanate Peak and Islamisation of the Afar and Issa. Led to the emergence of Ottoman Red Sea Expansion.
